maddeler.e:
ننقرض (form VII)
# نَنْقَرِضُ (nanqariḍu) /nan.qa.ri.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
# نَنْقَرِضَ (nanqariḍa) /nan.qa.ri.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
# نَنْقَرِضْ (nanqariḍ) /nan.qa.ridˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
